run_submitit_job: run a multi-node GPU training job on a Slurm cluster using submitit AutoExecutor
submit_trainer_checkpoint: submit a Trainer instance to the executor and requeue on checkpoint for fault tolerance
parse_args_submitit: parse command-line arguments for GPU count, nodes, timeout, partition, and job name
setup_gpu_args: setup GPU rank, world size, and output directory from the submitit JobEnvironment
get_init_file: generate a unique initialization file URI for distributed training process group setup
